name: Calculator
highLevelGoals: The user aims to perform fundamental mathematical calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division accurately and efficiently using the smartphone app.
The user desires a simple and clear interface that allows for easy input of numbers and selection of operations, ensuring a smooth and frustration-free calculation experience.
The user expects the calculation results to be displayed prominently and updated instantly after each operation, enabling quick verification of answers.
lowLevelGoals: The user can input a single digit (0-9) into the calculator's display.
The user can input a decimal point to perform calculations with non-integer numbers.
The user can select the addition operator to prepare for an addition calculation.
The user can select the subtraction operator to prepare for a subtraction calculation.
The user can select the multiplication operator to prepare for a multiplication calculation.
The user can select the division operator to prepare for a division calculation.
The user can press the equals button to execute the pending arithmetic operation and display the result.
The user can press a 'Clear' or 'AC' button to reset the calculator display and any pending operations.
The system should display the numbers and operators entered by the user in real-time.
The system should display the calculated result prominently after an operation is executed.
The calculator display should update instantly as digits or operators are pressed, providing immediate feedback.
